## Featured updates

[Image of a person flushing their dental unit waterlines using the A-dec Flush Dock over a sink]

#### How to Clean and Maintain Dental Unit Waterlines

Learn a clear, step-by-step approach to dental unit waterline (DUWL) maintenance—from choosing the
right water source to monitoring, shocking, and flushing treatments.

[Read article][128]
[A dental office employee looking at the Link AI inbox]

#### AI Dental Receptionist: Turn Missed Calls Into Revenue

Learn how AI dental receptionist software helps streamline scheduling, communication, and front desk
workflows.

[Read article][129]
[A-dec Impact logo]

#### A-dec Donates $1 Million to Dental Trade Alliance Foundation

A‑dec announced a transformative $1,000,000 endowment, in partnership with The Dental Trade Alliance
Foundation.

[Read press release][130]
[A-dec and Dentsply Sirona collaboration logos]

#### A-dec and Dentsply Sirona Expand Partnership

A‑dec and Dentsply Sirona expand their strategic partnership by integrating the Midwest Motor System
into A‑dec Pro delivery systems.

[Read press release][131]
[Two curved dark blue arrows containing the words A-dec Buyback Program]

#### A‑dec Buyback Program

Get cash back for your used A‑dec dental equipment.

[Learn more][132]
[Townie awards for A-dec dental equipment]

#### Thank you, Townie dentists

Since 2003, Dentaltown magazine's online community of dental professionals has consistently named
A‑dec products as the best across multiple categories.

[About the awards][133]
[3D visualization of A-dec dental equipment coming out of a phone]

#### 5 Tips and Tricks for Dream in 3D

From starting with a blank room or uploading photos of an existing space, to using AI-generated
color palettes, AR/VR visualization, and easy sharing tools, see how doctors can plan their
operatories with confidence.

[Read article][134]

## A-dec+ connected dentistry

Simple. Reliable. Intuitive. Imagine an updatable software platform that keeps your dental practice
ready for whatever lies ahead.

[Explore A-dec+][135]
[A-dec+ web and mobile application]

## Featured resources

Dream in 3D

Explore A‑dec dental equipment in 3D, and see products in your space with AR. Customize colors and
materials, and order free color samples.

[Explore Dream in 3D][136]

Order color samples

Order free A‑dec upholstery and cabinet color samples.

[Find your perfect color][137]

A‑dec buyback program

Get cash back for your A‑dec dental equipment—and get our best deal when you purchase new A‑dec
equipment at the same time.

[A-dec buyback program][138]

Customer stories

Hear why doctors choose A‑dec dental equipment to design healthy, comfortable, and high-quality
dental office experiences.

[Watch videos][139]

[TOTALOP - An all-inclusive operatory subscription service offering top-of-the-line dental equipment
for one affordable and predictable monthly cost.][158]

# DENTAL EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIES FROM A TRUSTED MANUFACTURER

At DENTALEZ, we have always understood what matters to dentists. Our dental products have been
carefully designed with the features you rely on most, from our revolutionary J-Chair to our smart
products with Aeras Intel.

# DENTAL EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIES FROM A TRUSTED MANUFACTURER

At DENTALEZ, we have always understood what matters to dentists. Our dental products have been
carefully designed with the features you rely on most, from our revolutionary J-Chair to our smart
products with Aeras Intel.

## [TOTALOP ][159]

Now, we offer a first-of-its-kind solution, [TotalOp][160], an all-inclusive operatory subscription
service offering top-of-the-line chairs, compressors, vacuum, handpieces, and other leading dental
equipment, for one affordable and predictable monthly cost.

[][161]

## [DENTAL EQUIPMENT][162][][163]

Built on a foundation of premium engineering, the Forest 5400 balances durability, patient comfort,
and clinical functionality—at just the right price.

[][164]

## [DENTAL HANDPIECES ][165]

#### Star E900 Electric Handpiece System
#### Introducing an entirely ***new electric*** handpiece system from DENTALEZ.
#### *Smart Integration,
#### One Comprehensive System*

[][166]

## [DENTAL UTILITY ROOM EQUIPMENT ][167]

##  

Our Ramvac line of vacuums and compressors is renowned for its durability and reliablity; and we
continue to make them smaller, quieter, more powerful, more safe and more flexible.

[][168]

## [BE IN CONTROL WITH AERAS INTEL ][169]

DENTALEZ® smart products feature Aeras Intel that gives you the ability to collect data, share
information, and streamline your standard-of-care. This creates an ecosystem of patient care and
practice efficiency.

[][170]

## [DENTAL TEACHING AIDS, MODELS AND EQUIPMENT ][171]

We’re the industry standard in customizable teaching aids, helping prepare the next generations of
dental practitioners.

[][172]

We continue to innovate to answer the needs of our dentists and their patients. We manufacture and
supply the products and equipment that let you focus on what you do best - providing great dental
healthcare.

That’s peace of mind. Discover what DENTALEZ can do for you.

[][173]

#### [TRUSTED FOR OVER 100 YEARS][174]

Enjoy the proven performance of the brands you know and love, enhanced with cutting-edge technology
that helps you run an efficient, meticulous practice.

[LEARN MORE][175]
[][176]

#### [CUSTOMER CARE][177]

Our products are designed to provide exceptional value over the long term. That’s why they carry
some of the best warranties available, backed by responsive, expert customer service.

[YOU'RE COVERED][178]
[][179]

#### [A WELCOME COLLABORATION OF PRODUCTS AND KNOWLEDGE][180]

Dental Solutions & Technology (DSX), the sales organization from DENTALEZ, is filled with some of
the most knowledgeable sales representatives in the dental industry. Connect with your rep!

The NEW biodegradable HOOPLA™ Retractor maximizes oral cavity access and visibility by comfortably

procedure.

##### FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

Here you will find answers to the most frequently asked question. If you don’t find what you’re

How much is teeth cleaning in manila

Standard prices of teeth cleaning procedures in Manila ranges from 700 to 1,500 pesos depending on
the your dentist. It’s best to check and compare different prices offered by your nearby dental
clinics, and also ensure that you are choosing licensed and qualified professional.

Can you keep your teeth healthy without a dentist?

Absolutely, keeping a good oral hygiene and health are should be a priority with or without a
dentist. However, there are certain cases and dental procedures that may require professional
assistance to aid your dental problems. Keep your teeth healthy at home by:
* Brushing your teeth regularly.
* Eating a healthy diet. Preferably low in sugar and avoid snacking between meals.
* Limit tobacco, and alcohol consumption.
* Drinking plenty of water to keep yourself hydrated.
* Keep dental floss into your oral hygiene routine.

Is Dentist covered by PhilHealth?

Reviewing the complete list of covered services with PhilHealth or your health insurance provider
ensures a comprehensive coverage for your dental needs. It’s crucial to consider that the extent of
PhilHealth coverage may vary based on your membership category and insurance plan. Contact us at
Alora Dental Clinic to learn more.

What food kills mouth bacteria?

Foods should only be a complementary but not a substitute for a good oral hygiene practices like
regularly brushing your teeth, flossing, and dental check-ups. Nevertheless, here are some of the
foods that can help fight mouth bacteria:
* Crunchy fruits and vegetables like apples and carrots.
* Dairy products like cheese and yogurt.
* Foods that are high in vitamin c, such as citrus fruits.
* Green and black teas.
* Foods that are high in calcium and phosphorus, such as almonds, are excellent at strengthening
  tooth enamel and supporting oral health.

How many times should you get your teeth cleaned?

Teeth cleaning frequency recommendation depends on each individual’s oral health cases. For someone
who regularly visits their dentist and has good oral health hygiene habits, ones or twice a year is
enough. However, for those with gum disease, cavities, and other dental concerns, may required a
frequency of every 3 to 4 months. It’s best to consult your dentist for personalized
recommendations.

Do deep cleanings hurt?

The level of discomfort from deep cleaning varies from person to person, but if properly done, the
procedure shouldn’t be painful. If you are concerned about this during a deep cleaning session, it’s
best to let your dentist know about your concerns and any options to increase comfort.

Can mouthwash remove tartar?

Mouthwash may prevent the buildup of plaque, a film of bacteria that can cause tartar formation, but
it cannot eliminate tartar that has already formed on teeth. Make sure to schedule an appointment
with your dentist for expert recommendations.

What is the best time to see the dentist?

To maintain optimal oral health, it is advised to schedule regular dental check-ups and cleanings at
least twice a year. By doing so, any potential dental problems can be detected early and treated
promptly, ensuring healthy teeth and gums.

How do I calm my nerves before a dentist appointment?

For some individuals, a dental appointment can evoke feelings of anxiety due to past traumatic
experiences or memories of pain. A good way to ease your nerves before an appointment are practicing
deep breathing, listening to music, bringing a friend or family, and being open with your dentist.
Alora Dental Clinic prioritizes every patient’s comfort and promote a stress-free procedure as much
as possible.

What damages teeth the most?

There are several factors that can contribute to a damage teeth. Some of the common culprits are
poor oral hygiene, sugary foods, acidic foods, tobacco use, excessive grinding and clenching. By
avoiding these factors, you can lessen the risk of damaging your teeth.

# Trusted dental care in quezon city, from our family to yours!

[ Talk to us, we don't bite ][72]

## What makes us smile?


## No more waiting, confusion, or surprise costs...

Dental issues are stressful enough—booking an appointment shouldn’t be. At Alora Dental Clinic, we
prioritize you with **strict appointment-based scheduling**, ensuring you’re never left waiting.

We keep you **informed every step of the way**, so you’re always comfortable and clear on your
treatment.

Plus, we **offer some of the best rates** around, without cutting corners on quality. Fast
appointments, simple procedures, and flexible payment options make dental care as stress-free as
possible!

## Our Dental Care Services

#### [General Dentistry][74]

Alora Dental Clinic offers consultations, restorations, extractions, fluoride, prophylaxis, and
more. We prioritize care and attention, keeping clients coming back.
[ [cosmetics] ][75]

#### [Dental Cosmetics][76]

Dental Cosmetics improves teeth and gum appearance via veneers, crowns, bridges, dentures,
whitening, and more. Boost your confidence with us at today.

[ [prosthodontics] ][77]

#### [Prosthodontics][78]

We design, manufacture, and fit dental prostheses with patient’s comfort and confidence in mind.
From bridges to dentures and crowns, we prioritize satisfaction.

#### [Orthodontics][80]

Orthodontics diagnoses, prevents, and treats dental and facial abnormalities to restore and maintain
teeth functionality. Includes clear aligners, metallic, ceramic, sapphire, self-ligating, and more.
[ [IMG_7324] ][81]

#### [Oral Surgery][82]

Alora Dental Clinic provides excellent and personalized dental care, simplifying complex procedures
like Wisdom Tooth Extraction and Root Canal Treatment for our clients. Explore our services at Alora
today!

#### [Diagnostic Services][84]

Alora Dental Clinic offers fast, accurate, and highly accessible diagnostic procedures to cater to
your dental needs. Our service includes Periapical X-Ray and more.

Dentistry is an evergreen industry that is continuously growing along with the rise of technological

##### FAQ

## Frequently Asked Questions

Here you will find answers to the most frequently asked question. If you don’t find what you’re
looking for, feel free to contact us directly. We are always happy to assist you.

How much is teeth cleaning in manila

Standard prices of teeth cleaning procedures in Manila ranges from 700 to 1,500 pesos depending on
the your dentist. It’s best to check and compare different prices offered by your nearby dental
clinics, and also ensure that you are choosing licensed and qualified professional.

Can you keep your teeth healthy without a dentist?

Absolutely, keeping a good oral hygiene and health are should be a priority with or without a
dentist. However, there are certain cases and dental procedures that may require professional
assistance to aid your dental problems. Keep your teeth healthy at home by:
* Brushing your teeth regularly.
* Eating a healthy diet. Preferably low in sugar and avoid snacking between meals.
* Limit tobacco, and alcohol consumption.
* Drinking plenty of water to keep yourself hydrated.
* Keep dental floss into your oral hygiene routine.

Is Dentist covered by PhilHealth?

Reviewing the complete list of covered services with PhilHealth or your health insurance provider
ensures a comprehensive coverage for your dental needs. It’s crucial to consider that the extent of
PhilHealth coverage may vary based on your membership category and insurance plan. Contact us at
Alora Dental Clinic to learn more.

What food kills mouth bacteria?

Foods should only be a complementary but not a substitute for a good oral hygiene practices like
regularly brushing your teeth, flossing, and dental check-ups. Nevertheless, here are some of the
foods that can help fight mouth bacteria:
* Crunchy fruits and vegetables like apples and carrots.
* Dairy products like cheese and yogurt.
* Foods that are high in vitamin c, such as citrus fruits.
* Green and black teas.
* Foods that are high in calcium and phosphorus, such as almonds, are excellent at strengthening
  tooth enamel and supporting oral health.

How many times should you get your teeth cleaned?

Teeth cleaning frequency recommendation depends on each individual’s oral health cases. For someone
who regularly visits their dentist and has good oral health hygiene habits, ones or twice a year is
enough. However, for those with gum disease, cavities, and other dental concerns, may required a
frequency of every 3 to 4 months. It’s best to consult your dentist for personalized
recommendations.

Do deep cleanings hurt?

The level of discomfort from deep cleaning varies from person to person, but if properly done, the
procedure shouldn’t be painful. If you are concerned about this during a deep cleaning session, it’s
best to let your dentist know about your concerns and any options to increase comfort.

Can mouthwash remove tartar?

Mouthwash may prevent the buildup of plaque, a film of bacteria that can cause tartar formation, but
it cannot eliminate tartar that has already formed on teeth. Make sure to schedule an appointment
with your dentist for expert recommendations.

What is the best time to see the dentist?

To maintain optimal oral health, it is advised to schedule regular dental check-ups and cleanings at
least twice a year. By doing so, any potential dental problems can be detected early and treated
promptly, ensuring healthy teeth and gums.

How do I calm my nerves before a dentist appointment?

For some individuals, a dental appointment can evoke feelings of anxiety due to past traumatic
experiences or memories of pain. A good way to ease your nerves before an appointment are practicing
deep breathing, listening to music, bringing a friend or family, and being open with your dentist.
Alora Dental Clinic prioritizes every patient’s comfort and promote a stress-free procedure as much
as possible.

What damages teeth the most?

There are several factors that can contribute to a damage teeth. Some of the common culprits are
poor oral hygiene, sugary foods, acidic foods, tobacco use, excessive grinding and clenching. By
avoiding these factors, you can lessen the risk of damaging your teeth.

What's in every report

## Investor-grade diligence. Not a vibe check.

Every report runs 30 sections across two deep analyses — so you walk into any investor meeting with
evidence, not hope.

Validation Report 30 sections
01Problem statement

A crisp articulation of the core problem your idea sets out to solve, framed the way a customer
would feel it.

02Problem validation

Evidence on whether the problem is real, frequent and painful enough that people will actually pay
to solve it.

03Ideal customer profiles (ICPs)

The specific segments, triggers and buying motions worth targeting first — and the ones to
deprioritise.

04Market sizing (TAM, SAM, SOM)

Defensible top-down and bottom-up estimates so you know whether this is a feature, a company, or a
category.

05Market opportunity

Where demand, timing and tailwinds line up in your favour — and how big the opening really is.

06Cartesian competitive positioning map

A two-axis map showing exactly where you'd sit against rivals, and which quadrant is still open.

07SWOT analysis

Strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats assessed honestly — no cheerleading.

08Unique selling proposition (USP) analysis

What makes you genuinely different — and whether that edge is defensible over time.

09Pricing strategy

Models, tiers and price points that fit your market, your margins and your customers' willingness to
pay.

10Validation plan

A concrete, step-by-step plan to test the riskiest assumptions cheaply before you commit real
resources.

11Expected growth rate (CAGR) & revenue timeline

Realistic growth and revenue projections mapped over time, with the assumptions behind them.

12Recommendations

Clear, prioritised guidance on what to do next — and what to leave alone for now.

13Challenging questions

The hard questions a sharp investor or skeptic will ask — so you have answers ready.

14Additional insights

Notable findings that don't fit neatly elsewhere but materially shape the decision.

15System flow

How the product, users and value move through the system, from first touch to retention.

16Project Analysis sources

The references, datasets and citations that underpin the project analysis above.

17Competitors list

A curated roster of the players you'll be up against, direct and indirect.

18Customer profiles (ICPs)

Who each competitor actually serves today, and where their attention is focused.

19Unique selling propositions (USPs)

How rivals position and differentiate themselves — and the claims they lean on.

20Features matrix

A side-by-side comparison of what each competitor offers, and where the gaps are.

21Pricing matrix

How competitors package and price, mapped together so the white space is obvious.

22Strengths and weaknesses

Where each competitor is strong, and where they're exposed enough for you to attack.

23Market share

Who owns what slice of the market today, and how concentrated the field is.

24Market value

The size and value of the space these competitors play in, in hard numbers.

25Target region

The geographies each competitor focuses on, and which markets are still under-served.

26Growth rate (CAGR)

How fast each competitor — and the market as a whole — is actually growing.

27Additional insights

Extra competitive intelligence worth knowing before you pick your angle.

28Competitor landscape diagram

A visual map of the competitive field that shows clusters, leaders and open lanes at a glance.

29Actionable takeaways for a fundraising founder

The concrete moves to make given everything the landscape reveals.

30Competitor Analysis sources

The references, datasets and citations that underpin the competitor analysis.

dispose of it. Along with this, another question raised is what the reasons are we can’t reuse it

# THE QUALITY PRODUCTS YOU TRUST

BY YOUR SIDE

At Brasseler USA, we choose to do one thing exceptionally well:
design and provide the highest-quality dental instrumentation.

[Explore Our Products][36]

## PRODUCTS

See all the high-quality dental essentials Brasseler USA has to offer.

[Learn More][37]

## RESOURCES

Download product literature, IFUs, technique guides, and more!

[Learn More][38]

## EDUCATION

Stay up-to-date on the industry’s latest innovations and procedural trends.

[Learn More][39]

# By Your Side is more than just our tag line.

At Brasseler USA, our mission is to advance dentistry by being By the Side of the dental community
enabling them to deliver the best care to their patients.

Since 1976, we have provided the highest-quality instruments to healthcare professionals for use in
Restorative Dentistry, Endodontics, Prosthodontics, Periodontics, Orthodontics, Pedodontics,
Oral-Maxillofacial Surgery, Dental Hygiene, and dental laboratories.

### Expert handpiece repair.

Brasseler has been by your side, expertly and efficiently repairing medical and dental handpieces
and small equipment for over 25 years. We know handpieces are a significant investment for your
practice, and when things go wrong, Brasseler Handpiece Repair is here to help protect that
investment—no matter the brand!

[Get Started][40]

### Propelling the profession forward through clinical collaboration.

Collaboration with leading dental clinicians helps us identify opportunities for new products and

service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data

publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the

## The features that make people say wait, really?

Referral Portal

### Your referring dentists deserve better than an expired link.

Our HIPAA-compliant referral portal gives referring dentists their own private login. They can
access every report, every letter, and every shared file in history, anytime, without waiting on you
to resend anything. Full-resolution images. Full CT volumes with their own viewer. No flash drives.
No Dropbox. No seven-day expiration windows. Just everything they need, exactly when they need it.

Nobody else in Endo does this. We checked.

AI Referral Letters

### From clinical note to referral letter in four seconds.

Your Endodontist already wrote the clinical note. The referral letter is just a refined version of
what already happened. So we built an AI that reads the clinical note, adapts to the patient’s
specific diagnosis and treatment, and generates a complete professional referral letter in three
clicks. What used to take 15 minutes now takes under 4 minutes. For a practice seeing 10 to 15
patients a day that’s hours back in your week. Every week.

Electronic Patient Intake

### Paperwork done before they walk in the door.

The moment an appointment is scheduled, patients receive a request to complete their intake forms
electronically. Demographics. Medical history. Insurance information. Consent forms. Financial
agreements. All of it comes back automatically loaded into their chart. No transcription. No manual
entry errors. No liability from mismatched information. Patients arrive already informed, already
prepared, and already signed off. That’s 15 to 20 minutes back per patient before the day even
starts.

eRx Included

### Every provider needs to prescribe. So we just included it.

Electronic prescribing through Dosespot is built into DentalEMR at no additional charge. Patient
data passes over automatically. Prescriptions go straight to the pharmacy, including controlled
substance compliance. We included it because it’s not optional for an Endo practice. Charging extra
for it never made sense to us.

Best in class, by design

## We do what we do best.
## Our integrations handle the rest.

We’re not trying to be everything. We’re trying to be exactly what an Endo practice needs and we’ve
chosen best-in-class integrations for the workflows that go beyond core practice management. Every
integration is intentional. Every integration was chosen because they’re the best at what they do.

# Finally.
# Endo software that doesn’t make you settle.

Built by Endodontists. Web-based. Fully loaded. No surprises.

[See It In Action][8]
[See What’s Included ↓][9]

Let’s be honest for a second.

## The software industry has some explaining to do.

Somewhere along the way, dental software decided it was okay to charge you extra for everything.

$ Support$ Mobile access$ eRx$ Cloud backups$ Locations$ Users$ Anything else

Then they raise prices every year. Call it an upgrade. And hand you a server that needs its own IT
person, its own maintenance schedule, and its own prayer circle when something goes wrong.

> “
> 
> And if you’re an Endodontist? They hand you software built for a general dentist and say close
> enough.

We looked at all of that and said no thanks.

There’s a better way to run an Endo practice. It looks like this.

The better way

## DentalEMR. Built for Endo.
## Built for you.

We built DentalEMR because Endodontists deserved a solution that actually understood how their
business works. Not a general dentistry platform with a coat of paint. A purpose-built,
referral-focused, fully loaded practice management ecosystem designed around the way Endo actually
runs.

Web-based from day one. Supported by humans who pick up. Priced in a way that makes you wonder why
everyone else charges so much more for so much less.

We don’t sell software. We sell solutions. And we’re just getting started.

For Endodontists

### Practice Endo
### Not Software

DentalEMR handles the clinical and admin work behind the scenes so you can focus on what matters
most: your patients.

[AI Referral Letters][10] [Referral Portal][11] [Clinical Workflows][12] +2 more
[Treatment Planning][13] [Outcome Tracking][14]
[Built For Your Practice →][15]

For Practice Managers

### Run Everything
### Without Juggling

One platform for scheduling, billing, insurance, reporting, and more so your day runs smoother.

[Scheduling][16] [Billing][17] [Patient Intake][18] [Insurance Claims][19] [Reporting][20] +2 more
[Referral Tracking][21] [Collections][22]
[Built For Your Workflow →][23]

For Startups

### Built For Endo
### Startups

Everything you need to launch, grow, and scale your practice from day one backed by a team that's
been there.

[Consent Forms][24] [Billing Setup][25] [Referral Workflows][26] +2 more
[Scheduling Templates][27] [Insurance Strategy][28]
[Built For Your Launch →][29]

Proof, not promises.

## The numbers don’t lie.

<1%

Of your overall revenue spent on our platform

70 hr

Saved per provider per month with AI-assisted referral letter writing

30 min

Saved per patient with electronic intake. No transcription. No liability.

8 yrs

Serving Endodontists with zero price increases to existing customers

$0

The cost of every update and AI feature for existing customers

What sets us apart

## Why DentalEMR hits different.

We could use words like innovative and intuitive here. But we’d rather just show you what’s actually
included.

### True web-based. Not cloud-washed.

Open Google Chrome. Log in. That’s the whole installation. No servers. No hardware. No IT
maintenance. No software to download or update. Works on any device, anywhere. We were the first
true web-based solution for Endos. And we’re proud of it.

### Support is included. Full stop.

Real humans on the other side of the chat. AI-powered answers for when you need something fast. Bug
reporting that goes straight to our product team. Feature requests that actually get considered. No
support tiers. No extra charge. No hold music. Just help when you need it.

### Everything included. Nothing hidden.

eRx. AI-assisted workflows. Referral portal. Full CT volume sharing. Electronic patient intake.
Kiosk mode. Follow-up reminders. Broadcast messaging. All of it comes standard. We’ve never raised
prices on existing customers. Every update we’ve ever shipped has been free. We keep building the
canyon wider between what you pay and what you get.

### Built for Endo. Not adapted for it.

General dentistry runs on recare. Endo runs on referrals. Two fundamentally different business
models. Two fundamentally different software needs. DentalEMR was built from the ground up around
the referral-based model: tracking relationships, communicating with referring dentists, and keeping
treatment moving from first contact to final restoration. Our attention isn’t split with general.
It’s 100% on Endo.

What’s actually included

## The features that make people say wait, really?

Referral Portal

### Your referring dentists deserve better than an expired link.

Our HIPAA-compliant referral portal gives referring dentists their own private login. They can
access every report, every letter, and every shared file in history, anytime, without waiting on you
to resend anything. Full-resolution images. Full CT volumes with their own viewer. No flash drives.
No Dropbox. No seven-day expiration windows. Just everything they need, exactly when they need it.

Nobody else in Endo does this. We checked.

AI Referral Letters

### From clinical note to referral letter in four seconds.

Your Endodontist already wrote the clinical note. The referral letter is just a refined version of
what already happened. So we built an AI that reads the clinical note, adapts to the patient’s
specific diagnosis and treatment, and generates a complete professional referral letter in three
clicks. What used to take 15 minutes now takes under 4 minutes. For a practice seeing 10 to 15
patients a day that’s hours back in your week. Every week.

Electronic Patient Intake

### Paperwork done before they walk in the door.

The moment an appointment is scheduled, patients receive a request to complete their intake forms
electronically. Demographics. Medical history. Insurance information. Consent forms. Financial
agreements. All of it comes back automatically loaded into their chart. No transcription. No manual
entry errors. No liability from mismatched information. Patients arrive already informed, already
prepared, and already signed off. That’s 15 to 20 minutes back per patient before the day even
starts.

eRx Included

### Every provider needs to prescribe. So we just included it.

Electronic prescribing through Dosespot is built into DentalEMR at no additional charge. Patient
data passes over automatically. Prescriptions go straight to the pharmacy, including controlled
substance compliance. We included it because it’s not optional for an Endo practice. Charging extra
for it never made sense to us.

Best in class, by design

## We do what we do best.
## Our integrations handle the rest.

We’re not trying to be everything. We’re trying to be exactly what an Endo practice needs and we’ve
chosen best-in-class integrations for the workflows that go beyond core practice management. Every
integration is intentional. Every integration was chosen because they’re the best at what they do.

[Meet Our Integrations →][30]

Customer stories

## Don’t take our word for it.

These are real practices. Real teams. Real results.

Jackie Mitchell

DentalEMR is web-based, fully loaded, and built by people who actually understand what it takes to
run an Endo practice. Let’s show you what that looks like for yours.

No pressure. No hard sell. Just a real conversation about what you need and whether we’re the right
fit.

and advancements in dentistry. 300+ top dental suppliers engaged with visitors who got hands-on with
thousands of clinical products, and accessed exclusive deals - only available at Dental Showcase.**

Leading clinicians and experts took part in our first-class educational lecture programme. Visitors
engaged in lively debates, got up-to-speed with the latest innovative dental techniques, and
discovered solutions to enhance their practices. With 5 conference theatres, the welcome return of
the hands-on clinical workshops, 70+ hours of enhanced CPD, 120+ expert industry speakers, and
more networking opportunities than you could shake a stick at, BDIA Dental Showcase remains the
ultimate platform to learn, save, and connect with the entire dental profession.

manufacturers and suppliers, showcasing excellence and fostering innovation to elevate oral care
standards.

investment in the future success and relevance of your brand within the industry. It's a chance to
connect, innovate, and inspire alongside the brightest minds and most influential players in
dentistry today.

If you'd like to find out more about partnering with us in 2027, get in touch today.

**BDIA Main Stage**

modern dentistry.

[Pearl]

**BDIA Main Stage**

The Business of Belonging: Lessons in Brand, Culture, and Care

longevity.

DeNovo Dental Partners will be speaking to none other than Mary Portas to find out how dental
practices can create a sense of culture and community among patients and teams alike. They will
explore the importance of brand and ethics in business and healthcare; elevating the patient
experience; building community; fostering a growth-minded work culture; and so much more.

# Partnering to Deliver Better Patient Care.

The innovative companies that are part of Envista help dental professionals deliver the best
possible patient care, every step of the way. We know that dental professionals do more than create
healthy, beautiful smiles—they create confidence. To achieve their goals, they need a champion. At
Envista, we're uniquely positioned to be this champion.

[ About us ][16]

### 2025 Annual Report

New Report

##### Just Released: Our 2025 Annual Report.

[**Learn more**][17]

Anchored by Envista’s value of Continuous Improvement, the Envista Business System (EBS) is our
foundation for success.

# Who We Are

Envista is a global family of more than 30 trusted dental brands, united by a shared purpose: to
partner with professionals to improve lives. Envista helps its partners deliver the best possible
patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

[ Watch video ][18] [ More about us ][19]

### Transforming the Dental Industry

The Envista portfolio of brands is dedicated to supporting, expanding, and improving how dental
professionals care for their patients. Focused on innovation and the future of the digital
landscape, we provide quality products and solutions for the dental office and beyond.

[ Learn more about Envista ][20]

### Side by Side

From digital consultation and modeling tools to superior equipment and surgical instruments, Envista
companies support dental professionals at every patient interaction, with increasingly integrated
digital workflows. Our comprehensive training and education programs offer career-spanning
professional growth.

[ Explore our businesses ][21]

## Specialty Products & Technologies

Envista's Specialty Products & Technologies division develops and manufactures a wide variety of
dental products, including dental implant systems, prosthetics, clear aligners, bracket and wires,
orthodontic and lab products, and the technology to match.

**[Learn more][22]**

## Equipment & Consumables

Envista's Equipment & Consumables segment develops and manufactures dental equipment and consumable
supplies used in dental offices, including digital imaging systems, dental practice equipment,
endodontic systems, restorative and impression materials, bonding agents and cements, and infection
prevention products.

**[Learn more][29]**

Our brands in this segment:

  ][30]

### We champion creators of confidence.

Creating confidence is no small business. With deep industry roots and decades of world-class
experience, the people behind Envista know this well. Our companies help dental professionals
deliver the best possible patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

# Partnering to Deliver Better Patient Care.

The innovative companies that are part of Envista help dental professionals deliver the best
possible patient care, every step of the way. We know that dental professionals do more than create
healthy, beautiful smiles—they create confidence. To achieve their goals, they need a champion. At
Envista, we're uniquely positioned to be this champion.

[ About us ][16]

### 2025 Annual Report

New Report

##### Just Released: Our 2025 Annual Report.

[**Learn more**][17]

Anchored by Envista’s value of Continuous Improvement, the Envista Business System (EBS) is our
foundation for success.

# Who We Are

Envista is a global family of more than 30 trusted dental brands, united by a shared purpose: to
partner with professionals to improve lives. Envista helps its partners deliver the best possible
patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

[ Watch video ][18] [ More about us ][19]

### Transforming the Dental Industry

The Envista portfolio of brands is dedicated to supporting, expanding, and improving how dental
professionals care for their patients. Focused on innovation and the future of the digital
landscape, we provide quality products and solutions for the dental office and beyond.

[ Learn more about Envista ][20]

### Side by Side

From digital consultation and modeling tools to superior equipment and surgical instruments, Envista
companies support dental professionals at every patient interaction, with increasingly integrated
digital workflows. Our comprehensive training and education programs offer career-spanning
professional growth.

[ Explore our businesses ][21]

## Specialty Products & Technologies

Envista's Specialty Products & Technologies division develops and manufactures a wide variety of
dental products, including dental implant systems, prosthetics, clear aligners, bracket and wires,
orthodontic and lab products, and the technology to match.

prevention products.

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

  Information about vaccinations for babies, children and adults, including why they're important
  and how to get them

## Good. So Are We.

#### AI that Actually Works

Forget the buzzwords. At GAINS, AI isn’t a magic trick — it’s a practical tool we’ve been using for
decades built into the core of how decisions get made.

AI alone isn’t the answer — it’s just a tool. Without deep supply chain expertise, it’s just math in
a black box.

At GAINS, AI is embedded across our platform — but always guided by decades of real-world,
domain-specific knowledge. That’s how we turn intelligence into outcomes.

[ See How We Use AI ][124]

### Move Fast. No Overhauls. No Lock-In.

GAINS delivers real outcomes in weeks, not years.

No rip-and-replace. No vendor lock-in. No “trust the roadmap.”

We work with what you’ve got, plug in what you need, and help you move forward — one smart decision
at a time.

## AI is a tool. Expertise is the advantage. GAINS brings both.

[ Learn About DEO® ][126]

## What Got You Here Won’t Get You There.

Traditional systems weren’t built for the speed, volatility, or complexity of today’s supply chains.
They slow decisions, trap teams in outdated assumptions, and bury impact under layers of
disconnected tools.

Process-heavy approaches aren’t solving the problem — they’re compounding it.

That’s why we created DEO:
Decision Engineering & Orchestration®.

It’s not another layer of tech. It’s a smarter, connected way to make and execute high-impact supply
chain decisions — across every time to plan horizon, from strategic design to daily execution.

DEO® brings speed, clarity, and precision to how your supply chain thinks and responds. So you’re
not just reacting faster — you’re creating value faster.

faster—outthink and outperform.

GAINS brings decades of domain expertise together with AI, proven decision science, and a modular
architecture — empowering companies to evolve confidently and deliver measurable results in weeks,

We don’t just stop at our award-winning design solution. GAINS integrates design insights directly
into planning and execution workflows. No handoffs, no siloed strategies—just a connected,
continuously improving system.

][132] [

**Composable and Future-Ready**

Our composable architecture lets you evolve your design tech as new tools, solvers, or data streams
emerge. You’re never locked in—just always ahead

**Not Just Software. ****A Real Partner.**

Our experts have helped optimize hundreds of networks. We don’t just hand over the tech—we co-design
strategies, run simulations, and ensure implementation sticks with our battle-tested proprietary
Proven-Path-to-Performance (P3) methodology and our Solutions Council of industry experts.

For over four decades, GAINS has empowered supply chain leaders with solutions that are not only

## Stories to live by. Lessons to inspire.

### Maria’s story

“If you have a disability, it’s really hard to find your place in this world,” says collegiate para
track and field athlete Maria Velat. After becoming paralyzed in high school, Maria found her way
back to sports, and now competes through the Adaptive Student Athlete Program (ASAP), a national
program co-founded by Guardian and University of Michigan Adaptive Sports and Fitness to expand
access to competitive opportunities for para athletes. Maria’s goal is to work toward a day when
adaptive sports are seen as equal.

Watch the video

### Caiden’s story

At 15, Caiden experienced a life-changing accident that paralyzed him, requiring the use of a
wheelchair. His life changed again when he picked up a tennis racquet. After a rocky start, his
wheelchair tennis team took second place at the national championships, and Caiden's sense of
community and sportsmanship was able to shine through again.

Watch the video

### A lifetime of good oral health

From the time a child’s first tooth comes in, how they learn to take care of their teeth can have a
positive impact on their health and well-being for years to come. Guardian helps our youngest
members establish a lifetime of good oral health and well-being.

Watch the video

### Building financial education with EVERFI

Financial health has an outsized impact on the well-being of the whole you. So, we partnered with
EVERFI to deliver a free digital financial education course that teaches high school students about
different financial stages in life, how money and mental health are intertwined, and how money can
affect interpersonal relationships.

Watch the video

### Greer’s story

Greer’s husband unexpectedly passed away, leaving her with two young children and a brand new home.
Her careful planning with her financial professional allowed her to get back to focusing on what
mattered.

Watch the video

### Ed and Mary Ann’s story

After 57 years of marriage, Ed and Mary Ann were facing their greatest challenge yet — pancreatic
cancer. But careful planning with their financial professional set them up for financial confidence
to enjoy their time together.

Watch the video

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

][1][[ Merle Shane McDow: US Navy Atlantic Command 'These two gentlemen began to question me about
this event. They were being pretty rough about it, to be honest with you. I remember literally
putting my hands up and saying, ‘Wait a minute fellows. I am on your side. Just a minute.' Because
they were not really nice. They were very intimidating and made it quite clear to the point that
nothing that was seen, heard, or witnessed, that transpired was to leave this building. ‘You are not
to say a word about it to your co-workers. And off base, you just forget everything that you may
have seen or heard concerning this. It didn't happen...'' Lt. Col. Charles Brown: US Air Force
(Retired) 'It is sort of strange but we send people to prison, we send people to their death because
of eyewitness accounts of crimes. Our legal system is based on that to a large degree. Yet in my
following of unusual aerial phenomena for the past 50 years, there seems to be some reason to
discredit very viable and very reputable witnesses when they say something is unidentified... 'I do
know that there are agencies of our Government that can manipulate data. And you can create or
recreate [whatever you want]. Craft, intelligently operated craft, have basically violated our laws
of physics on this planet. And they have done that for a long time. The fact that the Government at
this point — I know we have been investigating since 1947 — has not come up with an answer, to me
indicates that there is something seriously wrong. Are we this incompetent in science? I don't think
so. Are we this incompetent in intelligence? I know we are not this incompetent in intelligence.
Now, Project Blue Book, when it was closed by Dr. Condon's group, I have every reason to believe
that this was a total deliberate whitewash.... 'UFOs have been investigated for an extended period
of time and the general public is not being made aware, fully aware — but are given only bits and
pieces, programmed responses and things like that.' 'Dr. B': 'I know that some people I worked with
did disappear on certain programs and were never heard from again. They just disappeared. There has
been evidence of that all through my work. You know, that people go out on projects [and disappear].
But [to protect myself from this] I wouldn't go any further on a project because I could see
something strange coming. So, a lot of people have disappeared you know, that are higher up.' Lance
Corporal Jonathan Weygandt: US Marine Corps ''You weren't supposed to be there.' ‘You are not
supposed to see this.' ‘You are going to be dangerous if we let you go.' I thought that they were
going to kill me, really... 'They had a Lieutenant Colonel from the Air Force and he did not
identify himself. And he told me, ‘If we just took you out in the jungle, they would never find you
out there.' I didn't want to test him to see if he would really do that so I just said, ‘Yeah.' And,
he said, ‘You have got to sign these papers. You never saw this.' I 'don't exist' and 'this
situation never happened.' And if you tell anybody, you will just come up missing...' 'They are
yelling at me and hollering and cursing. ‘You didn't see anything. We will do you and your whole
goddamn family.' 'It was basically that for about eight or nine hours... ‘We are going to take you
off in a helicopter and we are going to kick your ass out in the jungle and we are going to end
you...' 'These different agencies are on their own. They don't obey the law. They are rogue. Do I
think that this is a project that goes up through the government and everyone has a piece in it? No.
I think these guys operate on their own and no one knows what they do. It is so easy to do today.
And there is no oversight, no control. They just do whatever they want... 'Lethal, deadly force has
been used. For those of you who don't know, I know marine snipers and I have heard other guys talk
about it and I've heard that these guys go on the streets and they stalk people and they kill them.
I know that the Army Airborne snipers do the same thing. They use Delta Force to go grab these
people and silence them by killing them.' Maj. George A. Filer, III: US Air Force (ret.) 'At times I
used to carry nuclear weapons. In other words, I was mentally fit to carry nuclear weapons, but I'm
not mentally fit if I see a UFO. This criticism and this ridicule have done more to keep the story
coming out than almost anything else.' Nick Pope: British Ministry of Defense Official 'I believe
that governments and the military, and indeed private researchers, politicians- whoever- should
place everything in the public domain on this issue. Governments can't, I think, have it both ways.
You cannot say on the one hand, as the party line often goes, that UFOs are of no defense
significance, and then on the other keep back some of the data. 'You simply can't do that. You have
to have it one way or the other. And if, as governments consistently say when the politicians probe
on this issue or when the media inquire, that there's really nothing to worry about, then okay,
let's see all the data.' Larry Warren: US Air Force, Security Officer 'We were gone over with a
Geiger counter and there was one return on one of the guys, and something was taken out of his
pocket. This guy was removed very quickly. And, I will swear on my life, I never saw him again. He
was removed. This happened to a lot of people. It led to a suicide that the Air Force is responsible
for. This is a real person with a real name... 'We were brought in and there were sheets on top of
the law enforcement desk. There were about 10 of us. And there were one, two, three, four, five,
six, seven stacks of documents, pre-typed. One was a pre-typed statement, all generic, of what we
saw — which was not what we saw. It said we were off- duty and saw only unknown lights flipping
amongst the trees. I clearly remember that. I said, what if we don't sign this, Major Zigler? And,
he says, you have no choice. And, he says, I have no choice but to ask you to do this... 'Two people
came up behind each of us, and I do remember someone heading toward him, and I heard the sound of
what sounded like an aerosol. And, I went black. My nose ran profusely and my chest got tight. I,
obviously, was not getting into the car properly, so I was beaten, literally hit in the ribs and
pushed... Anyway, I have 20 minutes of recall and I'm gone for a day. And, it's established with
other people. People said I was on emergency leave or on leave or off the base. But I was just under
the base. And, there were other personnel down there. '...I had marks, by the way, from an IV, or
something, when I came out of there. I had the bruise and I had a bandage. I will admit that. That's
for real. I had it. I'm terrified to know or think of what might have happened... 'The only reason I
have my records is because I was advised to steal some of them, by an Air Force Colonel, because he
said they would vaporize you. He said, they are going to fireproof you. I was looked at, almost like
a Frank Serpico kind of guy. I was not a team player because I was talking to everyone...
'Unfortunately, my friend, Alabama, went AWOL trying to get back home. At O'Hare Airport, he was
captured by the FBI and returned to duty immediately. All he wanted to do was go home. But he was
put back on flight duty. I was riding with the senior master Sergeant on vehicle patrol, just
totally depressed with everything, when Alabama called in — this is a real person — and said he was
going to kill himself if he couldn't go home. And, this guy turned the pick-up truck quick and was
heading toward the post. He said, you stay on the goddamn radio... I saw all the units across the
flight line responding and everything. Anyway, Alabama had a short M16, and he put it in his mouth,
and took the top of his head off. This was the first time I ever saw death, violent death, at 19. We
were as different as night and day, me and this kid. You know, he was the south, I was the north. He
was very religious. I respect that, but we had nothing in common. He was a nice guy. And, they did
not do anything to help us...' Sgt. Clifford Stone: US Army 'During the discussion of UFOs, the
question, ultimately, is going to come up, can any government keep secrets, let alone the U.S.
Government? And the answer to that is unequivocally yes. But one of the greatest weapons the
intelligence community has at their disposal is a predisposition by the American people, the
American politicians and the debunkers — people who wish to try to debunk UFO information. They
immediately come out and say, oh, we can't keep secrets, we can't keep secrets. Well, the truth is,
yes, we can. 'The National Reconnaissance Office remained secret for many, many years. The mere
existence of the NSA remained secret. The development of the atomic weapon remained secret until
once you exploded one you eventually had to tell some people what was going on. 'And we are
conditioned by our own paradigms not to accept the possibility or probability of a highly advanced
intelligent civilization coming here to visit us. You have evidence in the form of highly credible
reports of objects being seen, of the entities inside these objects being seen. Yet, we look for a
prosaic explanation and we throw out the bits and pieces of the evidence that doesn't meet our
paradigm. So it is a self-keeping secret. You can conceal it in plain sight. It is political suicide
to go and start hitting up intelligence agencies to get this information released. So, most of your
members of Congress, and I know I've worked with a lot of them along that line, will balk and try
not to do it. I can name you three members of Congress that were point blank asked to have a
congressional inquiry on what happened here at Roswell... 'We have got to get the documentation as
it exists in the Government files. We have got to get it released before it ultimately is destroyed.
A good example is the Blue Fly and Moon Dust files. I had classified documents the Air Force
acknowledged. When I got members of Congress to help me open up more files, they were immediately
destroyed and I can prove this. 'Somewhere along the line, they may see that material and realize
there is some very highly sensitive information that would have a damning effect upon the national
security of United States should it become compromised. It needs to be further protected, to insure
that there is only a limited access to that information to a small number of people. So small you
can put them on a list of paper, on a piece of paper, and list them by name. Thus, you have the
special access programs. The controls that were supposed to be put on the special access programs
are not there. When Congress did their review of the way we protect documents, and the way we go
ahead and implement our secrecy programs, they found that you had special access programs within
special access programs — that is was essentially impossible to keep control of them all by
Congress. And, I'm telling you right now; it is essentially impossible to keep control of them all.
'When it comes to UFOs, the same criteria applies. Therefore, only a small nucleus within the
intelligence community, numbering less than a hundred — no, I'd suggest less than 50 — control all
that information. It is not subject to congressional review or oversight at all. So, Congress needs
to go ahead and ask the hard questions and convene a hearing.' Master Sgt. Dan Morris: US Air Force,

**FEEL THE DIFFERENCE**

## Making dental care safe, efficient and pleasant

**At LM-Dental™ we make dental instruments with pride. Our goal is to make dental care a pleasant
experience for both patients and dentists, by designing instruments that are safer and more
efficient than ever before.**

**We’ve been designing innovative and high-quality dental products for decades now, relying on our
Nordic heritage of continuous improvement, excellent service, and high standards to create genuine
value**.

**Our products are trusted by dental professionals around the world.**

[Read more about LM-Dental**™** company][50]

## LM-Arte**™** Instruments with Non-stick Coated Tips

All* **LM-Arte™ instruments** are available with **LM Dark Diamond™ non-stick coated tips**,
offering an exceptional diamond-like feel and enhanced precision.

The **LM Dark Diamond™ coating** improves composite placement and sculpting by reducing stickiness.
Its **dark color** maximizes contrast against fillings and minimizes reflections, making procedures
more **pleasant and efficient**.

[Read more ][51]

**Excluding LM-Arte**™** Cusp Misura*

### NEW Tapia Contact Shaper

The Tapia Contact Shaper instrument is an innovative **molar-form-inspired matrix burnisher and
composite plugger,** developed in cooperation with **Dr. Javier Tapia.** It improves matrix
burnishing in posterior restorations by enabling to shape a contact that closely follows the natural
tooth anatomy.

[Read more][52]

### L**M™ Prepare and Build-up Kit**

The special kit is designed to reduce clinical stress by enhancing **predictability**,
**efficiency**, and **long-term durability** of restorations. LM™ Prepare and Build-up Kit is
developed in collaboration with **Dr. Rui Falacho**, to optimize the workflow for **indirect
adhesive restorations**.

[Read more][53]

## Microsurgical LM**™** Instruments

Discover the innovative **LM™ instrument line** for periodontal microsurgery, offering exceptional
**versatility**, **delicacy**, and **sharpness** for advanced surgical techniques.

Developed with **Dr. Axel Endruhn**, the design is based on his **IETS protocol**, focusing on
**patient care**, **clinical efficiency**, and **minimizing post-op challenges**.

[Read more][54]

## Your Skills Deserve LM**™** Instruments

When you have expert skills, you deserve the best tools. At **LM-Dental™**, we focus on the needs of
dental professionals—collaborating closely with clinicians to stay at the forefront of **instrument
design and production**.

Choose instruments crafted for precision, comfort, and performance.

**Use LM™ hand instruments—designed for experts.**

[Browse LM**™** Hand Instruments][55]

## Growing Happy Smiles – My LM-Activator™

What’s better than a happy smile? With** early orthodontic intervention **you can help ensure your
child’s smile stays as happy as it can be. 

**My LM-Activator™** is a prefabricated silicone activator and aligner designed to support **healthy
growth and development of the face and jaw.** Early intervention can significantly **reduce of even
eliminate** the need for further treatment.

[Learn more at LM™ Orthodontic Appliances website][56]

## The Pioneer in Hand Instrument Ergonomics

Why are **LM-Dental™ hand instruments** so comfortable to use? It’s all about **ergonomic design**.
Since the beginning, LM-Dental™ has focused on combining an **ergonomic grip** with **high tactile
sensitivity** to deliver the best possible clinical results.

[Learn more about Instrument Ergonomics][57]

**FEEL THE DIFFERENCE**

## Making dental care safe, efficient and pleasant

**At LM-Dental™ we make dental instruments with pride. Our goal is to make dental care a pleasant
experience for both patients and dentists, by designing instruments that are safer and more
efficient than ever before.**

**We’ve been designing innovative and high-quality dental products for decades now, relying on our
Nordic heritage of continuous improvement, excellent service, and high standards to create genuine
value**.

**Our products are trusted by dental professionals around the world.**

[Read more about LM-Dental**™** company][50]

## LM-Arte**™** Instruments with Non-stick Coated Tips

All* **LM-Arte™ instruments** are available with **LM Dark Diamond™ non-stick coated tips**,
offering an exceptional diamond-like feel and enhanced precision.

The **LM Dark Diamond™ coating** improves composite placement and sculpting by reducing stickiness.
Its **dark color** maximizes contrast against fillings and minimizes reflections, making procedures
more **pleasant and efficient**.

[Read more ][51]

**Excluding LM-Arte**™** Cusp Misura*

### NEW Tapia Contact Shaper

The Tapia Contact Shaper instrument is an innovative **molar-form-inspired matrix burnisher and
composite plugger,** developed in cooperation with **Dr. Javier Tapia.** It improves matrix
burnishing in posterior restorations by enabling to shape a contact that closely follows the natural
tooth anatomy.

[Read more][52]

### L**M™ Prepare and Build-up Kit**

The special kit is designed to reduce clinical stress by enhancing **predictability**,
**efficiency**, and **long-term durability** of restorations. LM™ Prepare and Build-up Kit is
developed in collaboration with **Dr. Rui Falacho**, to optimize the workflow for **indirect
adhesive restorations**.

[Read more][53]

## Microsurgical LM**™** Instruments

Discover the innovative **LM™ instrument line** for periodontal microsurgery, offering exceptional
**versatility**, **delicacy**, and **sharpness** for advanced surgical techniques.

Developed with **Dr. Axel Endruhn**, the design is based on his **IETS protocol**, focusing on
**patient care**, **clinical efficiency**, and **minimizing post-op challenges**.

[Read more][54]

## Your Skills Deserve LM**™** Instruments

When you have expert skills, you deserve the best tools. At **LM-Dental™**, we focus on the needs of
dental professionals—collaborating closely with clinicians to stay at the forefront of **instrument
design and production**.

Choose instruments crafted for precision, comfort, and performance.

**Use LM™ hand instruments—designed for experts.**

[Browse LM**™** Hand Instruments][55]

## Growing Happy Smiles – My LM-Activator™

What’s better than a happy smile? With** early orthodontic intervention **you can help ensure your
child’s smile stays as happy as it can be. 

**My LM-Activator™** is a prefabricated silicone activator and aligner designed to support **healthy
growth and development of the face and jaw.** Early intervention can significantly **reduce of even
eliminate** the need for further treatment.

[Learn more at LM™ Orthodontic Appliances website][56]

## The Pioneer in Hand Instrument Ergonomics

Why are **LM-Dental™ hand instruments** so comfortable to use? It’s all about **ergonomic design**.
Since the beginning, LM-Dental™ has focused on combining an **ergonomic grip** with **high tactile
sensitivity** to deliver the best possible clinical results.

[Learn more about Instrument Ergonomics][57]

# Welcome


# Meet the Doctors


# Meet the Doctors


**Stuart M. Patterson, DDS**

                Dr. Stuart Patterson received his undergraduate degree in Criminal Justice from
Appalachian State University and completed his graduate dental degree from UNC-Chapel Hill School of
Dentistry in 2006.  He is a member of American Dental Association, North Carolina Dental Society and
the Alamance-Caswell Dental Society.  A Burlington native, Dr. Stuart and his wife, Crissy, have 1
daughter (Emily).  He enjoys time with family, being outdoors, and spending time in the mountains.

Left to Right: Crissy, Emily, Boone and Dr. Stuart.

**Nathan W. Patterson, DDS**

                Dr. Nathan Patterson received his undergraduate degree in Biology from UNC-Chapel
Hill and completed his graduate degree from UNC-Chapel Hill School of Dentistry in 2014.  He is a
member of the American Dental Association and the North Carolina Dental Society.  During his last
year of school Dr. Nathan was selected by the director of Operative Dentistry to be a teaching
assistant in the Conservative Operative Dentistry course, helping teach pre-doctoral dental students
learn the basics of restorative dentistry.  A Burlington native, Dr. Nathan and his wife,
Tiffany, have one son (Nolan) and one daughter (Finley).  He enjoys spending time with friends and
family, sports, and traveling. Dr. Nathan’s wife (Tiffany) is a doctor of physical therapy and is
currently a home health physical therapist, so be on the lookout for her if you’ve had a recent
joint replacement as she may just end up as your therapist.

Left to Right: Dr. Nathan, Finley, Nolan and Dr. Tiffany.

**David S. Patterson, DDS**

**                **Dr. David Patterson received his undergraduate degree in Chemistry from Elon
University and completed his graduate dental degree from UNC-Chapel Hill School of Dentistry in
1982.  He is a member of the American Dental Association, North Carolina Dental Society and the
Alamance-Caswell Dental Society.  Dr. David has also served on the Board of Directors for the UNC
Dental Alumni Association and the Alamance County Board of Health.  Born in Roanoke, Virginia, Dr.
David moved to Burlington at the age of 5 and has since been a lifelong resident of Alamance
County.  He and his wife, Ruth, have 3 sons, 3 grandsons and 2 granddaughters.  He enjoys time with
family, boating, travel, playing electric guitar and spending time at the coast. You will not catch
Dr. David in the office much these days, unless he is here for his own dental appointment or the
occasional social visit :-)

[Top][22]

**PHONE**

(336) 226-9078

**HOURS**

Monday - Thursday 7am - 3pm

**LOCATION**

2879 Rob Shepard Drive

Alamance, NC 27201

## SOME LOVE FROM OUR CUSTOMERS

[**VIEW MORE**][226]

"My PDT instruments stay sharp longer, have a nice and light weight grip while adapting well to the
tooth surface; they make my day easier! Montana Jack and Queen of Hearts are my favorites."

- Guylaine Blais

"PDT instruments stay sharp longer, are lightweight and contour perfectly against the tooth! They
feel great to use as a practitioner while achieving optimal patient comfort."

- Bettina Lew

"I love everything about PDT! The ordering is a snap, customer service is top notch, shipping is
quick, (made in the USA) the instrument angles are perfect and keep a blade much longer than the
competition."

- Danielle Whisler, RDH

"I love PDT instruments! The Montana Jack is the best instrument ever made. I could not live without
it. It can be easily adapted to almost every tooth. I could not do my job without it."

- Kristin VanLeuven Winslow

"I love the way PDT instruments adapt to the tooth surface and have the best grip, especially with
nitrile gloves!"

- Robyn Newbern Patterson

"I lived in Montana for 14 years, practicing clinical dental hygiene. During that time PDT was
created and created the best instruments I have ever used. Quality instruments and great people, I
wouldn't order anything else!"

- Ranae Mechura Maas

"I LOVE my PDT scalers! I have been using them for over 12 years and will never use anything else.
They are lightweight and sharp. The Montana-Jack is my all-time favorite. Thank you PDT!!!!"

- Jeana Schiele-Dittmer

"I took my CRDTS exam recently and used only PDT scalers and passed without being able to use a
cavitron! I am so thankful for the sharpness of PDT instruments! I was able to confidently scale
very heavy and tenacious calculus thanks to PDT!"

- Brittany Santos, RDH

"As a full time hygienist, I am only as good as my best instruments. Thank you PDT for the Montana
Jack and the Montana Jack 4/5. I want to also thank you for your consistent instrument donations to
the community clinic where I work."

- Jerilyn Thompson, RDH

"I LOVE PDT. I don't know what I would do without my Montana Jack! PDT is my go-to company for the
best instruments and best quality!"

- Jessica Bosch-Dunbar

## SOME LOVE FROM OUR CUSTOMERS

[**VIEW MORE**][226]

"My PDT instruments stay sharp longer, have a nice and light weight grip while adapting well to the
tooth surface; they make my day easier! Montana Jack and Queen of Hearts are my favorites."

- Guylaine Blais

"PDT instruments stay sharp longer, are lightweight and contour perfectly against the tooth! They
feel great to use as a practitioner while achieving optimal patient comfort."

- Bettina Lew

"I love everything about PDT! The ordering is a snap, customer service is top notch, shipping is
quick, (made in the USA) the instrument angles are perfect and keep a blade much longer than the
competition."

- Danielle Whisler, RDH

"I love PDT instruments! The Montana Jack is the best instrument ever made. I could not live without
it. It can be easily adapted to almost every tooth. I could not do my job without it."

- Kristin VanLeuven Winslow

"I love the way PDT instruments adapt to the tooth surface and have the best grip, especially with
nitrile gloves!"

- Robyn Newbern Patterson

"I lived in Montana for 14 years, practicing clinical dental hygiene. During that time PDT was
created and created the best instruments I have ever used. Quality instruments and great people, I
wouldn't order anything else!"

- Ranae Mechura Maas

"I LOVE my PDT scalers! I have been using them for over 12 years and will never use anything else.
They are lightweight and sharp. The Montana-Jack is my all-time favorite. Thank you PDT!!!!"

- Jeana Schiele-Dittmer

"I took my CRDTS exam recently and used only PDT scalers and passed without being able to use a
cavitron! I am so thankful for the sharpness of PDT instruments! I was able to confidently scale
very heavy and tenacious calculus thanks to PDT!"

- Brittany Santos, RDH

"As a full time hygienist, I am only as good as my best instruments. Thank you PDT for the Montana
Jack and the Montana Jack 4/5. I want to also thank you for your consistent instrument donations to
the community clinic where I work."

- Jerilyn Thompson, RDH

"I LOVE PDT. I don't know what I would do without my Montana Jack! PDT is my go-to company for the
best instruments and best quality!"

- Jessica Bosch-Dunbar

# Proceed.Fit's Mission of Affordable Healthcare for All

## Proceed.Fit: Your Gateway to Affordable Healthcare and Hospitalization Services

**At Proceed.Fit**, we are dedicated to making **affordable healthcare** accessible to everyone. As
a trusted healthcare technology platform, we ensure that people from all backgrounds can receive
high-quality medical care at **competitive rates**.

Our innovative platform connects users to top healthcare providers, offering cost-effective
**treatment options** without compromising quality. We understand the financial strain that comes
with medical care, which is why we prioritize **transparent pricing** and provide upfront cost
estimates for a wide range of treatments and procedures.

By partnering with leading hospitals, **fitness experts**, nutritionists, ambulance services,
diagnostic labs, and pharmacies, we secure **exclusive discounts** and offers for our users. Our
mission is to make healthcare more affordable and accessible, ensuring you receive the care you need
at a price that fits your budget.

**Discover a smarter way to manage your healthcare needs with Proceed.Fit.**

How does Resonate AI compare to other dental AI receptionists?

While there are 600+ competitors in the dental tech space, Resonate AI stands apart through our
unique combination of dental-specific expertise, proven ROI, and exceptional support. Our team's
deep AI background with multiple Machine Learning and AI patents ensures cutting-edge technology,
while our exclusive focus on dental practices means we understand your specific workflows. Unlike
generic solutions, we deliver measurable results – our clients consistently capture substantial
previously lost revenue, often in the six-figure range annually. We're transparent about our
capabilities and limitations, building trust through honesty rather than overselling. We also share
customer reference calls as part of our process for you to feel comfortable before working with us. 

How does Resonate AI ensure it sounds like my specific practice?

During onboarding, we customize your AI's personality, tone, and responses to match your practice
brand tone. Whether you prefer formal and professional or warm and conversational, we configure the
exact language, terminology, and style you want. We can even give your AI a name that fits your
practice (like "Katie" for a friendly touch). This customization ensures brand consistency –
patients experience the same caring communication whether they're talking to your AI or your staff.

Who is behind Resonate AI? (Founder story, team expertise)

Resonate AI was founded by Manjot Pal, a Microsoft alum with five AI patents and deep expertise in
artificial intelligence. Having dentists in his family, Manjot witnessed firsthand the frustration
of missed patient connections and lost growth opportunities. Our team combines AI expertise with
dental industry knowledge. We're not just tech people trying to sell to dentistry – we understand
your world.

Why did you focus specifically on dental practices?

Dental practices face a unique challenge: extremely high call volumes, complex scheduling needs, and
patients often in pain who need immediate response. Generic solutions don't understand the nuance
between emergency extractions and routine cleanings, or how to handle insurance conversations
specific to dentistry. We saw practices losing 30% of their calls and knew that solving this problem
right required dental-specific expertise. Plus, with family in dentistry, this mission is personal.

What's your approach to customer success?

We measure our success by your success – literally. Our customer success team stays hands-on through
implementation and beyond. We monitor your metrics, proactively suggest optimizations, and respond
to feedback immediately. We're constantly looking for ways to improve your results. We're only happy
when you're capturing more patients and growing revenue.

How do you continuously improve the AI?

Three ways: First, aggregated learning from millions of conversations helps us identify successful
patterns. Second, direct practice feedback shapes our development priorities – if multiple practices
need something, we build it. Third, our engineering team constantly refines the AI's language
understanding and response generation. Every month, the AI gets better at handling edge cases and
delivering natural conversations.

What's your vision for the future of dental patient communication?

We envision a world where no patient in pain waits for help and no practice misses growth
opportunities due to communication barriers. Beyond missed calls, we're building toward
comprehensive patient engagement – from first inquiry through treatment completion. Imagine AI that
handles the full patient journey, all while maintaining the human touch that builds patient
relationships.

# ROOTT ®  — The Smart Implant System. A–Z.

One system. Total clinical freedom. 



Long-term satisfaction for patients around the world.



ROOTT® is not just an implant company — it is a complete, intelligently engineered ecosystem
designed to support clinicians in every indication, every workflow, and every level of complexity.



From immediate loading to complex cases, from simplicity to advanced solutions, ROOTT® empowers
clinicians with confidence, consistency, and control. 



We strongly believe that everyone deserves access to world-class implants that restore health and
confidence. 

Through high scale, lean operations and fundamental education, we make implants more accessible and
affordable.

[Learn more][67]

## Why Clinicians Choose ROOTT®



### One Complete System for Every Indication

A unified implant concept covering conventional, basal, pterygoid and compressive solutions.

### 98% Proven Clinical Success

Backed by long-term clinical data and real-world outcomes, ROOTT® delivers predictable, reproducible
results you can rely on.

### Trusted in 80+ Countries Worldwide

Used daily by thousands of clinicians across the globe — from private practices to advanced surgical
centers.



### Reliable Quality. Uninterrupted Supply.

Precision manufacturing, rigorous quality control, and a stable global supply chain ensure
consistency you can trust — case after case. 

### Smart Choice. High Performance. Highly Affordable.

Premium clinical performance without premium barriers — designed to support growth, not limit it. 

## Engineered with Purpose. Driven by Vision.



At ROOTT®, innovation is not accidental.

Every design decision is made with one goal in mind: to simplify clinical work while expanding
treatment possibilities.

Our agile, R&D-driven approach allows ROOTT® to evolve continuously — responding quickly to
clinician feedback, clinical challenges, and real-world demands.


## Discover ROOTT R – The Pinnacle of Dental Implant Technology


This state-of-the-art implant system sets a new standard with its unparalleled stability and
innovative leak-resistant conical connection. It's designed for versatility, featuring adaptive
platform switching and a passive fit connection that excels in scenarios demanding additional load
capacity.

***Choose ROOTT R for a future-proof, reliable implant solution.***
