with the same connection platform between implant abutment and all superstructures.

One-piece implant for multiple unite screw-retained restorations with a wide screw

* Bone condensation design

For a comprehensive range of multiple Implant supported  restorations, clinicians need a
predictable **one-piece implant** solution capable of achieving high primary stability
for **immediate loading** across both the upper and lower jaws. This component must
offer **prosthetic flexibility** to manage divergence without compromising stability or requiring
complex multi-component restorations.

***Efficiency, Versatility, and FILO Integration***

[Learn more][70]

## ROOTT B/BS – Engineered to Bypass the Mandibular Nerve and Anchor in Dense Cortical Ridges.


ROOTT BASAL implants are specialized, one-piece implants designed specifically for **resorbed
ridges** and **immediate loading**. Their unique structural characteristics allow for predictable
placement in **height and width deficient bones** , offering an immediate solution for multiple unit
restorations across the upper and lower jaws. 




[Learn more][71]

### Why Telegram?

### Simple

**Telegram** is so simple you already know how to use it.

### Private

**Telegram** messages are heavily encrypted and can self-destruct.

### Synced

**Telegram** lets you access your chats from multiple devices.

### Fast

**Telegram** delivers messages faster than any other application.

### Powerful

**Telegram** has no limits on the size of your media and chats.

### Open

**Telegram** has an open [API][40] and source code free for everyone.

### Secure

**Telegram** keeps your messages safe from hacker attacks.

### Social

**Telegram** groups can hold up to 200,000 members.

### Expressive

**Telegram** lets you completely customize your messenger.

Why choose Ultra Dent Tools for your PDR needs ?

Ultra Dent Tools manufactures the highest quality Paintless Dent Removal / Repair (PDR) Tools
available to the industry today. The reason why our designs and tools are so effective is that they
are designed by our professional PDR technicians and used worldwide. Most of our tools are made
onsite, we send a confirmation email once your order has shipped along with the tracking number.

 Our high-carbon stainless-steel tools are specially designed, precision machined and hardened for
lasting strength and durability in practical use. Our PDR tools feature a patented finger-grip
design that is the most ergonomic on the market. We also proudly offer our new design,
the Adjustable Interchangeable Handle. Our patented lighting system is coveted as the most
professional lighting system available today for the PDR industry. All of our professional-grade
tools offer unprecedented versatility in real world work applications.

 

# **ULTRA QUALITY**

Ultra Dent Tools, Inc.'s tools have incredible strength and durability and have a **[LIFETIME
WARRANTY][113]** against breakage or corrosion on all of our stainless steel tools that are 3/16"
diameter or larger. All 1/8" diameter, flaretips and shaved tools come with a one-year limited
warranty. Ultra Dent Tools spring steel 5/32", 1/8", .100 and flaretips come with a one-year limited
warranty. One-year warranted tools will only be replaced one time. Proof of purchase is required.
Our warranty does not cover misuse of any tool. All warranty tool replacements require the return of
the original tool being replaced to an Ultra Dent Tools facility. All Ultra Dent Tools LED lights
are completely covered for one year. 

Choose from our standard set selections or design your own "custom" set. If you are just getting
started or need some advanced methods and techniques then check out our Ultra Dent Tools "Glue
Puller", "Body Shop" and "PDR Training" videos or DVDs in the accessories section of our tools
listing.

 

# **ULTRA SHIPPING**

Currently over eight hundred different Ultra Dent Tools PDR Tools and Accessories are kept in stock
and ready for shipping. **We ship Domestic and International * via FedEx or USPS ( For orders under
1 lb ) . **

### **We require signature release for all orders over $100 USD , to forgo please email our sales
### team.**

### ** [It is free to reroute your package to a FedEX pickup location ][114]**

**Rush Delivery available via email request. - Overnight **

**We do not offer shipping to P.0 Boxes, Third party mailers , frieght forwarders etc !**

We generally ship any purchased Products within*** One (1) to Three (3) business days *****of your
order date**. We will promptly notify you of any shipping delay. If we are unable to ship your order
within three (3) business days after the specified shipping date, your order will be canceled and
you will either not be charged or be provided with a full refund (as applicable).**We do not cover
any additional fees/taxes for imports.**

 IMPORTANT NOTICE RE: SPECIAL DELIVERY/HANDLING. The above delivery terms do not apply to Products
listed as “Special Delivery/Handling” in the Product Listing, such as for customized items or
pre-order items. For Products with Special Delivery/Handling, the delivery terms in the Product
Listing will apply.

# **MISSING ITEMS**

**MISSING ITEMS MUST BE REPORTED WITHIN TWO WEEKS OF RECEIPT OF SHIPMENT TO RECEIVE REPLACEMENT OR
CREDIT!**
